name: stabilize-real-story-review-envelope-recomputation
title: Keep real-story Prompt Envelope eligibility stable after reviewer-pass writes
description: On clean main, B-5952 produced fresh concept, quality, and test-coverage passes in multiple clean REVIEW rounds, yet REVIEW to TEST rejected every pass because eligibilityDigest, eligibilityReasonCodes, and reviewBasisDigest changed under authoritative recomputation. The targeted review-incremental-context smoke passes, so add a real-story-history regression and fix only the recomputation inconsistency without weakening envelope validation.
